tagline: A dense, working-class European side district — a major metro junction and one of Istanbul's most intensely urban residential areas.

items.name: Bağcılar Çarşı Lokantalari
items.description: Honest, inexpensive lokanta restaurants catering to local workers and residents. Very good value Turkish food.

tips: Bağcılar is on the M1B metro line (Bağcılar Meydan), with the M3 at Kirazlı — well connected to the city centre.
A transit and residential hub rather than a leisure destination.
Very affordable for both food and housing.
The Bağcılar metro station is one of Istanbul's busiest — a fascinating transit spectacle in itself.
